in_sanskrit.name: श्यामसुन्दर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lord of beauty in the form of darkness, Lord Shiva

in_hindi.name: श्यामसुन्दर
in_hindi.long_meaning: श्याम (Shyam) : तामसिक (Tamasic, relating to the god Shiva, darkness) + सुन्दर (Sundar) : सु (su) + दर (dar) सुकार्य विशेषज्ञ (beautiful, having good qualities)

in_tamil.name: சியம்சுந்தர
in_tamil.long_meaning: சியம் (Shyam) : சிவன் (Shiva, the dark god) + சுந்தர (Sundar) : ஸு (su) + ந்தர (nadar) ஜோட்டியல் (beautiful, aesthetically pleasing)

in_telugu.name: శ్యామసుందర
in_telugu.long_meaning: శ్యామ (Shyam) : శివదేశ (Shiva, the dark god) + సుందర (Sundar) : సు (su) + దర (dar) శోదేశ (beautiful, aesthetically pleasing)

in_marathi.name: Shyamsunder
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shyamsunder हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shyamsunder is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Shyam (dark) and Ishwara (God). This name signifies the God of the Sun and is widely revered in Hinduism.
